# vintage_net v0.13.12 - Table of Contents

> Network configuration and management for Nerves

## Pages

- [README](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [VintageNet Cookbook](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/cookbook.md)
- [Changelog](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [VintageNet](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.md): `VintageNet` is network configuration library built specifically for [Nerves
Project](https://nerves-project.org) devices. It has the following features
- [VintageNet.Connectivity.CheckLogic](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Connectivity.CheckLogic.md): Core logic for determining internet connectivity based on check results
- [VintageNet.Connectivity.Inspector](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Connectivity.Inspector.md): This module looks at the network activity of all TCP socket connections known
to Erlang/OTP to deduce whether the internet is working.
- [VintageNet.Connectivity.InternetChecker](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Connectivity.InternetChecker.md): This GenServer monitors a network interface for Internet connectivity
- [VintageNet.Connectivity.LANChecker](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Connectivity.LANChecker.md): This GenServer monitors a network interface for LAN connectivity
- [VintageNet.Connectivity.TCPPing](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Connectivity.TCPPing.md): Test connectivity by making a connection using TCP
- [VintageNet.DHCP.Options](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.DHCP.Options.md): DHCP Options

- [VintageNet.IP](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.IP.md): This module contains utilities for handling IP addresses.
- [VintageNet.IP.DhcpdConfig](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.IP.DhcpdConfig.md): This is a helper module for VintageNet.Technology implementations that use
a DHCP server.
- [VintageNet.IP.DnsdConfig](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.IP.DnsdConfig.md): This is a helper module for VintageNet.Technology implementations that use
the Busybox DNS server.
- [VintageNet.IP.IPv4Config](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.IP.IPv4Config.md): This is a helper module for VintageNet.Technology implementations that use
IPv4.
- [VintageNet.Interface](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Interface.md): Manage a network interface at a very high level
- [VintageNet.Interface.CommandRunner](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Interface.CommandRunner.md): The CommandRunner module runs commands specified in RawConfigs
- [VintageNet.Interface.EAPStatus](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Interface.EAPStatus.md): Status of an EAP connection.
- [VintageNet.Interface.IfupDaemon](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Interface.IfupDaemon.md): Wrap MuonTrap.Daemon to start and stop a program based on whether the network is up
- [VintageNet.Interface.NameUtilities](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Interface.NameUtilities.md): Module for classifying network interfaces

- [VintageNet.Interface.RawConfig](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Interface.RawConfig.md): Raw configuration for an interface
- [VintageNet.InterfaceRenamer](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.InterfaceRenamer.md): Wrapper around the `ip` command for renaming interfaces

- [VintageNet.InterfacesMonitor](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.InterfacesMonitor.md): Monitor available interfaces
- [VintageNet.NameResolver](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.NameResolver.md): This module manages the contents of "/etc/resolv.conf".
- [VintageNet.Persistence](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Persistence.md): Customize the way VintageNet saves and loads configurations

- [VintageNet.Persistence.FlatFile](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Persistence.FlatFile.md): Save and load configurations from flat files

- [VintageNet.Persistence.Null](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Persistence.Null.md): Don't save or load configuration at all.

- [VintageNet.PowerManager](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.PowerManager.md): This is a behaviour for implementing platform-specific power management.
- [VintageNet.PowerManager.PMControl](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.PowerManager.PMControl.md): Power management control GenServer
- [VintageNet.PowerManager.Supervisor](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.PowerManager.Supervisor.md): Supervision for all of the power management controllers

- [VintageNet.PredictableInterfaceName](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.PredictableInterfaceName.md): Handles predictable interface names by subscribing to the property table and
renaming matching interface names based on the configuration in application
environment.

- [VintageNet.Resolver.ResolvConf](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Resolver.ResolvConf.md): Utilities for creating resolv.conf file contents

- [VintageNet.Route](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Route.md): Types for handling routing tables

- [VintageNet.Route.Calculator](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Route.Calculator.md): This module computes the desired routing table contents
- [VintageNet.Route.DefaultMetric](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Route.DefaultMetric.md): Default module for prioritizing network interfaces
- [VintageNet.Route.IPRoute](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Route.IPRoute.md): This module knows how to invoke the `ip` command to modify the Linux routing tables

- [VintageNet.Route.InterfaceInfo](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Route.InterfaceInfo.md): Routing information for an interface

- [VintageNet.Route.Properties](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Route.Properties.md): This module contains helpers for updating the global routing properties.
- [VintageNet.RouteManager](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.RouteManager.md): This module manages the default route.
- [VintageNet.Technology](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Technology.md): Technologies define how network interface types work
- [VintageNet.Technology.Null](https://vintage-net.hexdocs.pm/VintageNet.Technology.Null.md): An interface with this technology is unconfigured
